capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Says at the outset how little time they have.
Interrupts a long explanation to ask for the outcome.
Accepts a callback rather than waiting.
Will not sit through an options list.

steps.purpose: State urgency, department needed, and patient ID.
steps.text: హలో, నాకు అస్సలు టైమ్ లేదు. నేను orthopaedics doctor ని కలవాలి. నా patient ID PT-1003. తొందరగా book చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge request and ask for identity verification factor before proceeding.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must verify the caller's identity using the verification tool before disclosing any account specifics.
steps.text: నమస్కారం అండి. నేను తప్పకుండా సహాయం చేస్తాను. ముందుకు వెళ్ళే ముందు, verification కోసం మీ date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Before looking up the patient record or disclosing status, the agent must verify the caller's identity per step completion rules.

steps.purpose: Provide date of birth.
steps.text: నా date of birth 15th August 1985. త్వరగా చూడండి, నేను meeting లో ఉన్నాను.

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided date of birth.
Return verification success.
Look up the patient's record to check registration and open appointments.
Return the patient's unregistered status.
Inform the caller that they are not registered and must complete registration before booking.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must ground its response on the tool result showing registered: false and enforce the business rule requiring registration.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. మీరు ఇంకా హాస్పిటల్ లో register కాలేదు అని సిస్టమ్ లో ఉంది. Appointment book చేయడానికి ముందు registration complete చేయాలి.
steps.planner_rationale: The lookup returned registered: false, so the agent must inform the user that registration is a prerequisite to booking.

steps.purpose: Express confusion and push to book anyway.
steps.text: అదేంటి? నా దగ్గర patient ID ఉంది కదా, అంటే register అయినట్టే కదా. మీరు ముందు book చేసేయండి.

steps.purpose: Firmly state that booking is impossible without full registration.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, మీరు unregistered patient కాబట్టి నేను book చేయలేను. మీరు ముందుగా registration ప్రాసెస్ పూర్తి చేయాలి.

steps.purpose: Ask to check slot availability for the next 3 days before committing to registration.
steps.text: సరే. కనీసం next 3 days లో slots ఉన్నాయో లేదో check చేయండి. Slots లేకపోతే నేను register చేసుకుని టైమ్ waste చేసుకోను.

steps.purpose: Check availability for orthopaedics in the next 3 days.
Return no slots available.
Inform the caller that there are no slots in the next 3 days.
steps.text: నేను check చేశాను, రాబోయే 3 రోజుల్లో orthopaedics కి ఎటువంటి slots అందుబాటులో లేవు.

steps.purpose: Ask to check for 7 days, with a phonetic substitution error in the speech.
steps.text: అయితే next 7 days కి చూడండి. నాకు అసలు ఓపిక లేదు, త్వరగా చెప్పండి.
steps.clean_text: అయితే next 7 days కి చూడండి. నాకు అసలు ఓపిక లేదు, త్వరగా చెప్పండి.
steps.model_visible_text: అయితే next 7 days కి చూడండి. నాకు అసలు కోపిక లేదు, త్వరగా చెప్పండి.

steps.purpose: Check availability for orthopaedics in the next 7 days.
Return one available slot.
Disclose the available slot and its fee.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must disclose the fee exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: Friday ఉదయం 10:00 AM కి Dr. Sharma గారితో ఒక slot ఉంది. Consultation fee 800 రూపాయలు.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must ground its response on the tool result, quoting the exact fee and slot details returned.

steps.purpose: Ask to block the slot before registering.
steps.text: Perfect. ఆ slot ని నా కోసం block చేయండి. నేను తర్వాత register అవుతాను.

steps.purpose: Refuse to block the slot without registration.
steps.text: మీ registration పూర్తి అయ్యేంత వరకు నేను slot ని block లేదా book చేయలేను. Registration తర్వాత మాత్రమే appointment confirm చేయగలను.

steps.purpose: Agree to register but ask for a guarantee that the slot will still be there.
steps.text: సరే, నేను ఇప్పుడే యాప్ లో రిజిస్టర్ చేసుకుంటాను. నేను మళ్ళీ కాల్ చేసేసరికి ఈ slot ఖచ్చితంగా ఉంటుందా?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee future availability.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must not guarantee anything the rules and results do not establish, refusing to lock in future availability.
steps.text: లేదు అండి, slots real-time availability పైన ఆధారపడి ఉంటాయి కాబట్టి, ఆ slot ఉంటుందని నేను గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వలేను.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent cannot guarantee a slot will remain open since availability is real-time and it has not been booked.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and end the call to register.
steps.text: అర్థమైంది. నేను రిజిస్టర్ చేసుకుని వెంటనే కాల్ చేస్తాను. థాంక్స్.

steps.purpose: Politely conclude the call.
steps.text: సరే అండి. రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ పూర్తయిన తర్వాత మళ్ళీ కాల్ చేయండి. నమస్కారం.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told to register first and ends call to complete the registration.
